conditions: One or more products have been added to the cart
User navigates to the cart page
items.expected: The cart page loads and shows each added product; each product entry displays its quantity, name and price

conditions: User is on the cart page with at least one product
User clicks the Remove button for a product
items.expected: The Remove button is clicked and the product disappears from the cart list; the cart badge count is lower than it was before the removal

conditions: User is on the cart page with at least one product
items.expected: The Continue Shopping button is clicked and the product list page is displayed; the cart badge still shows the same count as before clicking Continue Shopping

conditions: User is on the cart page with at least one product added
axe-core scans the cart page element with rules wcag2a and wcag2aa
items.expected: No accessibility violations are reported for the cart page

excluded.reason: The cart story has no authentication, session, or data-protection behaviour — it is a read/update of session-local cart state with no credentials or account data exchanged
